newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan passes on 30,000 tonne raw sugar tender.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan passes on 30,000 tonne raw sugar tender.

text.p: State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp passed on a tender for a 30,000 tonne shipment at a tender in New York on Thursday, a company official said in Taipei on Friday.
The shipment was slated for April delivery, the official said.
The invitation-only tender was placed on Thursday through Taiwan Sugar's representative office in New York with selected suppliers, and was to have been awarded a day later, the official said.
He said Taiwan Sugar would retender the shipment on February 12. The result will be announced the following day in Taipei.
